en: Wow, it's 3 degrees Kraklenheit. Keep looking.
Great ta meet ya.

We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.
It's a little damaged, but I should still be able to get some good information from this.
You should not be here! Slay them!
OH NOES!! BRB AS DRAGON! <PH>
We live only to serve the ancient one. DIE INTERLOPER!
Sure does seem like it's been a long time since anyone has relieved me from my post.
I'm going to stay here until I catch a 68 Pound Grouper!  You on the other hand want to fly off somewhere, am I right?
For the King!
Stop... need to catch.... my breath.

Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.$B$BWhile you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

Proper sustenance will keep a soldier alive long after the wounds of the battlefield should have finished $g him : her; off, $c. If we're to persevere in the Ahn'Qiraj War to come, we'll need all of the provisions that we can carry. I'm gathering up spotted yellowtail fish at this location before it is to be shipped out.$B$BAs of now we have $2101w, but we need to collect a total of $2103w if we're going to be able to feed everyone.
You've got more guts than brains, coming to me without the proper training. Go talk to somebody closer to your skill level, like the orc Kamari, who lives in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

The blue dragons themselves aren't here, but followers of Malygos are. I do not know why, but I can tell you this: wherever the blue dragons are, expect to find arcane magic. I wouldn't be surprised if the dragonspawn are here protecting something... perhaps something the Highborne left behind.
%s blood sprays into the air!
It appears as if I will have to step in and take care of you myself.
Hello, Antonio. It's good to see you safely made it here again. Let me know if you need anything.
I would train ye if I could, but ye need the services of someone a bit more... what's the word? Brainy! Look for Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge. Tell 'er Bronk sent ye!
We have won $2219W battles against the Scourge.  Gird yourself, $n, for this war is far from over.

Ye sure ye don't want to learn to be a warrior?  Well, it's yer hide on the battlefield.  If ye really want to learn to waggle yer finger, ye best talk to Magis Sparkmantle in the Thunderbrew Distillery.
The only good $R is a dead $R!
Take that!  The Drywhiskers will prevail!
Quickly! $n attacks!
May your spirit burn brightly, $n.
What can you tell me about the status of the Windshapers?
And thank you, $n.  Without your aid I may never have found my way to the Forsaken.
Hey Bly!  Bilgewizzle wants his divino-matic rod back!
But something went wrong, didn't it?
My father says that's just a story.
How many of our Lieutenants are alive, Vanndar?
You are mine, dreadsteed!  Your spirit is now bound to me!

You best have a seat then, this is gonna be a long one.$B$BWhen we initially arrived in Silithus, Mistress Mar'alith was the first of the night elves from Cenarion Hold to join the expedition. Our routine was nothing out of the ordinary: Form a party to venture into the various hives and search for lost artifacts.

The Creators use visitation as a means to reestablish control over seeded worlds when forces, both external and internal, upset the matrix dynamics associated with it.  Such tactics are not to be taken lightly when executed by the Creators.$B$BFor additional information on this world's scheduled visitation, please consult the appropriate data repository that fields all Creator-related scheduling considerations.
%s causes a gale to sweep across the land, the sound of his mindless fury coming from the northwest.

I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.
Driving a Steam Tank isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?
Time for the Gizleton Caravan to head on out! We'll be back soon but if you cannot wait, head north to Kormek's Hut. We open shop in about an hour.
Rupert Boch is his name.  I hear that he's upstairs in one of the rooms at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast end of town.
The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.
This constant, annoying resistance is futile, you maggots! There will be nothing in the end but death!
So... cold...
